goal.name: Java
goal.video_language_note: English: short topic videos from Bro Code, Coding with John and others; DSA from Kunal Kushwaha. Hindi: matching sections of CodeWithHarry or Learn Coding full courses.
career_outcomes: Use collections, generics, lambdas and streams
Build, test and version projects with Maven, JUnit and Git
Solve basic DSA problems for interviews
Build a Spring Boot REST API backed by a database
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official docs, open-licence books, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted material re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Video minutes are real YouTube durations with the +15% rule applied (see goal.last_link_check). Mocks and the revision allowance remain planning figures.
